changelog: Host static files on subdomains with automatic SSL. Create sites, upload files, add basic auth. CLI + API included.
summary: Host static files on subdomains with optional authentication. Use when you need to serve HTML, images, CSS, JS, or any static content on a dedicated subdomain. Supports file upload, basic auth, quota management, and automatic SSL via Caddy. Commands include sf sites (create/list/delete), sf upload (files/directories), sf files (list/delete).
